title: Feasible Search Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2609.16431v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Consider a situation wherein a decision maker sequentially searches for the best alternative among heterogeneous options with an arbitrary search order. The agent partially learns the value of an option when inspecting it. The information structure jointly determines the ex-ante and ex-post value of investigating each option, thereby shaping the entire learning path. We characterize the set of all search behaviors compatible with some information structure, which forms a polytope. A single information structure rationalizes all these search behaviors, which minimizes the agent's welfare among all information structures. Under certain symmetry assumption over primitives, we also examine the set of all feasible pairs of search and choice behaviors, with and without option sellers' price competition, and prove the same results. translated_abstract: 考虑这样一个情形：决策者在异质性选项之间按照任意搜索顺序依次搜索最优选项。当事人在考察某个选项时会部分地了解其价值。信息结构共同决定了考察每个选项的事前价值和事后价值，从而塑造了整个学习路径。我们刻画了与某种信息结构相容的所有搜索行为构成的集合，该集合形成一个多面体。单一的信息结构即可使所有这些搜索行为理性化，并且该信息结构在所有信息结构中使当事人的福利最小化。在关于基础要素的某些对称性假设下，我们还考察了搜索行为与选择行为所有可行配对组合的集合，包括存在与不存在选项卖家价格竞争两种情形，并证明了相同的结果。我们的研究不仅为分析信息如何塑造有序学习路径提供了一个简洁的框架，而且……（原文摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文刻画了与某种信息结构相容的所有可行搜索行为集合（形成一个多面体），并证明存在单一的信息结构能够使所有这些搜索行为理性化，同时使当事人在所有信息结构中福利最小化。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the set of all feasible search behaviors compatible with some information structure—which forms a polytope—and proves that a single information structure can rationalize all of them while minimizing the agent's welfare among all information structures.
